Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_RandomWaterCh: Chance (in percent) that the water supply will be restored at midnight.\nThis chance is checked every day at 00:00.\nDoesn't work if 'Always Enable Blackouts' is enabled.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_RandomWaterUn: Number of hours the water supply will stay active after being restored (e.g., until 5 AM, 12 PM, etc.).
Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_RandomPowerCh: Chance (in percent) that the electricity will be restored at midnight.\nThis chance is checked every day at 00:00.\nDoesn't work if 'Always Enable Blackouts' is enabled.
Sandbox_ImmersiveBlackouts_RandomPowerUn: Number of hours the electricity will stay active after being restored (e.g., until 5 AM, 12 PM, etc).
